t: Titan TTB1233DRH 600W corded percussion drill delivers reliable power for drilling and hammer drilling tasks. Designed for trade professionals and DIYers, the versatile tool handles masonry, steel and wood with ease, making it ideal for home renovations and site installations. Variable speed control up to 3000rpm ensures precise drilling across different materials, whilst the 13mm keyed chuck provides secure bit retention. Rubber-grip handle reduces vibration for comfortable handling, and the lock-on switch assists during continuous operation. Features a compact 1.9kg design which offers manoeuvrability in tight spaces, and replaceable carbon brushes to extend the service life of the motor. Supplied with a side handle, guide ruler and chuck key.
